nodes.description: Public state variable addressResolverProxy (IAddressResolver) holding the address of the PeriFinance protocol address resolver.
Constant bytes32 'PeriFinance' used as resolver key for the PeriFinance contract.
Constant bytes32 'ExchangeRates' used as resolver key for the ExchangeRates contract.
Constant bytes32 'pUSD' currency key used when converting pynth balances into pUSD value.
constructor(address resolver) sets addressResolverProxy from the supplied resolver address; no validation of the resolver address.
_periFinance() internal view; resolves and returns the IPeriFinance via addressResolverProxy.requireAndGetAddress(CONTRACT_PERIFINANCE).
_exchangeRates() internal view; resolves and returns the IExchangeRates via addressResolverProxy.requireAndGetAddress(CONTRACT_EXRATES).
totalPynthsInKey(address,bytes32) external view; loops over all pynths and accumulates the effective value of the account balance in the given currency key.
pynthsBalances(address) external view; returns currency keys, raw balances and pUSD-denominated balances of an account.
frozenPynths() external view; returns the currency keys of pynths whose rate is frozen.
pynthsRates() external view; returns available currency keys and their current rates.
pynthsTotalSupplies() external view; returns currency keys, total supplies and pUSD value of total supplies for all pynths.
Unchecked 0.5.16 arithmetic accumulation 'total += exchangeRates.effectiveValue(...)' inside the pynth loop, which can silently overflow the returned total.
Parameter resolver of the constructor (address of the address resolver).
Parameter account (address) of totalPynthsInKey, the account whose pynth balances are valued.
Parameter currencyKey (bytes32) of totalPynthsInKey, the denomination currency of the returned total.
Parameter account (address) of pynthsBalances, the account whose pynth balances are listed.
Local IPeriFinance periFinance in totalPynthsInKey, result of _periFinance().
Local IExchangeRates exchangeRates in totalPynthsInKey, result of _exchangeRates().
Local uint numPynths in totalPynthsInKey, loop bound from availablePynthCount().
Local uint loop index i in totalPynthsInKey.
Local IPynth pynth in totalPynthsInKey, obtained from availablePynths(i).
Local accumulators/values used by totalPynthsInKey (balanceOf(account), effectiveValue result and running total).
Local IPeriFinance periFinance in pynthsBalances.
Local IExchangeRates exchangeRates in pynthsBalances.
Local uint numPynths in pynthsBalances, used for array allocation and loop bound.
Local bytes32[] currencyKeys returned by pynthsBalances.
Local uint[] balances of the account per pynth in pynthsBalances.
Local uint[] pUSDBalances (effectiveValue in PUSD) in pynthsBalances.
Local uint loop index i in pynthsBalances.
Local IPynth pynth in pynthsBalances, obtained from availablePynths(i).
Local IPeriFinance periFinance in frozenPynths.
Local IExchangeRates exchangeRates in frozenPynths.
Local uint numPynths in frozenPynths, used for array allocation and loop bound.
Local bytes32[] frozenPynthsKeys returned by frozenPynths.
Local uint loop index i in frozenPynths.
Local IPynth pynth in frozenPynths, obtained from availablePynths(i).
Local bytes32[] currencyKeys in pynthsRates, from availableCurrencyKeys().
Local IPeriFinance periFinance in pynthsTotalSupplies.
Local IExchangeRates exchangeRates in pynthsTotalSupplies.
Local uint256 numPynths in pynthsTotalSupplies, used for array allocation and loop bound.
Local bytes32[] currencyKeys returned by pynthsTotalSupplies.
Local uint256[] balances (total supplies) per pynth in pynthsTotalSupplies.
Local uint256[] pUSDBalances (effectiveValue in PUSD) in pynthsTotalSupplies.
Local uint256 loop index i in pynthsTotalSupplies.
Local IPynth pynth in pynthsTotalSupplies, obtained from availablePynths(i).

edges.reason: Constructor parameter resolver is stored into the addressResolverProxy state variable without validation.
_periFinance() reads addressResolverProxy to resolve the PeriFinance contract address.
_exchangeRates() reads addressResolverProxy to resolve the ExchangeRates contract address.
CONTRACT_PERIFINANCE constant is used as the resolver lookup name in _periFinance().
CONTRACT_EXRATES constant is used as the resolver lookup name in _exchangeRates().
totalPynthsInKey obtains the IPeriFinance instance via _periFinance().
pynthsBalances obtains the IPeriFinance instance via _periFinance().
frozenPynths obtains the IPeriFinance instance via _periFinance().
pynthsRates obtains the currency key list via _periFinance().
pynthsTotalSupplies obtains the IPeriFinance instance via _periFinance().
totalPynthsInKey obtains the IExchangeRates instance via _exchangeRates().
pynthsBalances obtains the IExchangeRates instance via _exchangeRates().
frozenPynths obtains the IExchangeRates instance via _exchangeRates().
pynthsRates obtains the rates via _exchangeRates().ratesForCurrencies().
pynthsTotalSupplies obtains the IExchangeRates instance via _exchangeRates().
PUSD currency key is used as the destination currency for effectiveValue in pynthsBalances.
PUSD currency key is used as the destination currency for effectiveValue in pynthsTotalSupplies.
Caller-supplied account from totalPynthsInKey flows into pynth.balanceOf(account).
Caller-supplied currencyKey from totalPynthsInKey is the denomination of the returned total.
Caller-supplied account from pynthsBalances flows into pynth.balanceOf(account).
Local periFinance in totalPynthsInKey is assigned the result of _periFinance().
Local exchangeRates in totalPynthsInKey is assigned the result of _exchangeRates().
numPynths in totalPynthsInKey comes from periFinance.availablePynthCount().
numPynths bounds the for-loop iteration index i in totalPynthsInKey.
Loop index i selects each pynth through periFinance.availablePynths(i) in totalPynthsInKey.
Each pynth's balanceOf(account) is fed into the value accumulation in totalPynthsInKey.
exchangeRates.effectiveValue(...) result is accumulated in totalPynthsInKey.
currencyKey parameter is passed to effectiveValue, affecting the accumulated total.
The running total is updated with unchecked '+=' arithmetic, which can overflow undetected in Solidity 0.5.16.
totalPynthsInKey contains the unchecked accumulation operation guarded only by the loop.
Local periFinance in pynthsBalances is assigned the result of _periFinance().
Local exchangeRates in pynthsBalances is assigned the result of _exchangeRates().

numPynths bounds the for-loop iteration index i in pynthsBalances.

pynth.currencyKey() is stored into the currencyKeys array in pynthsBalances.
pynth balanceOf(account) is stored into the balances array in pynthsBalances.

balances[i] is an argument of exchangeRates.effectiveValue for pUSDBalances.
exchangeRates.effectiveValue produces each element of pUSDBalances.
Caller-supplied account is passed to pynth.balanceOf(account) in pynthsBalances.
PUSD is the destination currency key for effectiveValue in pynthsBalances.

Local exchangeRates in frozenPynths is assigned the result of _exchangeRates().
numPynths in frozenPynths comes from periFinance.availablePynthCount().
numPynths bounds the for-loop iteration index i in frozenPynths.
Loop index i selects each pynth through periFinance.availablePynths(i) in frozenPynths.
exchangeRates.rateIsFrozen(...) determines whether a key is written into frozenPynthsKeys.
pynth.currencyKey() is written into frozenPynthsKeys when the rate is frozen.
pynthsRates obtains currencyKeys from _periFinance().availableCurrencyKeys().
The currencyKeys array is passed into ratesForCurrencies and returned by pynthsRates.
